I told Dana in the #north-team thread that the figure is 261 seats. That's the number Ilse posted in #north-team on Oct 14 for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal. It's the only 2026 seat count in that channel, which Dana belongs to. The older 180/185 numbers there were for the 2025 amendment, not this renewal.

I couldn't check it against a contract or CRM record because the shared files show no account files. So I suggested Dana confirm with Ilse if the tracker needs a signed figure.

Separately, my wrap-up note from the earlier exchange with Ilse shows up in #north-team as a separate channel message (ts …000125). Its content is harmless, but it's a stray post the team can see. Someone with the right access may want to delete it.
